attributes.action: Give comedian Bob Mortimer a Knighthood
attributes.additional_details: It is a petition to bring to the attention of the UK government, the importance of Bob Mortimer and his services to comedy, British culture and entertainment. Hopefully through the backing of fellow comedy lovers, we will achieve this!
attributes.background: We the British public want the comedian, Bob Mortimer to receive a Knighthood for his services to comedy and entertainment.

rejection.details: Petitions concerning honours and knighthoods aren't allowed as they are not a matter directly the responsibility of Parliament or the Government.
